subject: Money
title: Ancient Tax Systems
description: A 60-second lesson on Ancient Tax Systems.

hook.text: Ancient Rome taxed everything: land, slaves, salt, even urine from public toilets.

buildup.text: Tax collectors in Rome were private contractors. They bid for the collection rights, then kept the surplus.

discovery.text: This created brutal incentives. Collectors overtaxed citizens to maximize their own profit.

twist.text: Jesus told a tax collector to follow him. Tax collectors were so hated they needed a moral rescue.

climax.text: Modern tax agencies replaced private collectors, but public resentment toward taxes never changed.

quiz.question: How did ancient Rome collect taxes?
options: Through private contractors who kept surplus
